stem: Joseph ran a 6-mile race in 48 minutes. Which graph has a slope that best represents Joseph's average rate of speed during the race?

options.label: F
options.text: Graph with y from 0 to 10, x from 0 to 10, a steep line from about (0,0) to (1,10)

options.label: H
options.text: Graph with y from 0 to 10, x from 0 to 10, a steep line from about (0,0) to (2,10)

options.label: G
options.text: Graph with y from 0 to 10, x from 0 to 10, a gentle line from about (0,0) to (10,1)

options.label: J
options.text: Graph with y from 0 to 10, x from 0 to 10, a vertical line at x=8 from (8,0) to (8,10)

visual_elements: Four graphs labeled F, H, G, J each titled Joseph's Rate, y axis Distance (miles), x axis Time (minutes)
